newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feddlot cattle market slow at $65 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feddlot cattle market slow at $65 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was rather slow, with slaughter steers and heifers steady, USDA said. Inquiry was moderate and demand fair. Sales confirmed on 1,800 slaughter steers and 1,200 slaughter heifers Monday.
For the week to date 11,400 head confirmed including 6,600 head previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100 lbs 65.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000 lbs 65.00.
Confirmed - 3,000 last week - 200 last year - holiday
Wk to date - 11,400 last week - 8,400 last year - holiday
